name: image_to_video
description: Generates an MP4 video from an input image and prompt using a Diffusers I2V model

image.description: Local image path or URL used as animation source

prompt.description: Text prompt describing desired motion and scene

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt to suppress artifacts

model_id.description: Hugging Face model id for image-to-video generation

width.description: Output width, must be a multiple of 16

height.description: Output height, must be a multiple of 16

num_frames.description: Number of frames in generated video

num_inference_steps.description: Inference steps for generation quality/speed trade-off

fps.description: Frames per second of saved MP4

seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible outputs

filename.description: Optional output filename (mp4 extension added automatically)
